inputs: G0 observation X and its original training-only scales, identities and masks
candidate: 257 empirical uniform quantiles per physical feature fitted on the same training draw, then original standardized K16 Lloyd dictionary
baseline: released training draw and identical K16 Lloyd dictionary without quantile mapping
sensitivity: omit one dataset from word fitting, score its validation subjects using existing G0 training scales
primary: per-validation-subject adjusted Rand index vs each arm's own full seed-17 partition, mean over 64 training resamples and three fits per resample, then equal subjects within dataset and equal datasets
secondary: full-cohort seed perturbations, omission of each training dataset, nonempty and supported words, effective vocabulary, constant-partition cases, training-only background plus word readouts at current and next patch
uncertainty: fixed four datasets, paired validation subject percentile bootstrap within dataset, 4000 reps; conditional on development panel and fixed training perturbations

selection.coverage: all 16 used and at least as many supported words as standard on validation
selection.attribute: current background-relative gain positive, within 5 percentage points of baseline, lower error than rotated IDs; blind and next-patch comparisons descriptive

null_hypothesis: four-bit rank dictionary fails the joint stability, support or attribute-retention criteria
stopping: complete all 828 fits on original public development panel, list all failures, decide separately by modality, no adaptive search or protected evaluation
